title: Cash Purchases Counted Toward an Item's Supply in the PAP Supply Replenishment Program
content:
**Rule.** For a refill request in the PAP Supply Replenishment Program, self-pay (cash) lines count toward an item's supply as follows:

1. when the enrollment shows a self-pay line for an item of the recorded equipment, each such item's latest self-pay line counts at its covered-through date;
2. when it shows no self-pay line for an item of the recorded equipment but shows one for the tubing type not in use, that line counts toward the tubing in use.

An item's supply runs out on the latest of the dates that count toward it. An enrollment with neither kind of self-pay line gains nothing under this rule.

## Terms

- **Items of the recorded equipment:** the interface and cushion item of the recorded mask style, headgear, the tubing in use (heated tubing when heated tubing is in use, otherwise standard tubing), disposable filters, and a water chamber when a humidifier is in use.
- **The tubing type not in use:** standard tubing (A7037) when heated tubing is in use; heated tubing (A4604) when it is not.

## Truth table

| Self-pay line for an item of the recorded equipment | Self-pay line for the tubing type not in use | What counts |
|---|---|---|
| yes | yes or no | each such item's latest self-pay line, at its covered-through date; the other tubing's self-pay line does not count |
| no | yes | that tubing line's covered-through date counts toward the tubing in use |
| no | no | nothing |

## Cases (hypothetical)

- Heated tubing in use; the only self-pay line on the enrollment is standard tubing covering through 30 September. Line 2 applies: 30 September counts toward the heated tubing.
- Same enrollment, plus a self-pay headgear line covering through 15 August: line 1 applies. Headgear's self-pay line counts at 15 August; the standard tubing line no longer counts toward the heated tubing.
